tei:div.tei:head: Prayer for Peace, a paraliturgical adaptation of Sim Shalom in the Union Prayer Book, revised edition (CCAR 1918)

tei:lg.tei:l: Grant us peace, Thy most precious gift,
O Thou eternal source of peace,
and enable Israel to be a messenger of peace
unto the peoples of the earth.
that it may ever be a stronghold of peace,
that it may ever be a stronghold of peace,
and the advocate of peace in the council of nations.
May contentment reign within its borders,
health and happiness within its homes.
Strengthen the bonds of friendship and fellowship
between all the inhabitants of our land.
and may the love of Thy name
Praise be to Thee, Giver of peace.

tei:note.tei:p: The Union Prayerbook for Jewish Worship, revised edition, part II (1922) has “councils of nations”. Abraham Cronbach, in The Jewish Peace Book (1932) has “and its advocate in the council of nations.”
